articles.summary: Nayara Energy, India's largest private fuel retailer, has slashed petrol prices by Rs 5 and diesel by Rs 3 per litre nationwide. This marks the first retail price cut in over two years, following a dip in global crude oil costs. While Nayara reversed its earlier March hike, state-run oil companies like IOC, BPCL, and HPCL have maintained their current rates, leaving consumers with differing prices across the country.
